data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 车票夹页
data.description: 她确认好站台，把车票夹进笔记本，随后又摸了摸口袋，确保钱包也带着。
data.camera: 中近景，车票与本子清晰
data.promptProse: Seated on a polished wooden bench in a bustling railway concourse, Angelina tucks a newly stamped train ticket between the pages of her travel notebook. A canvas weekend bag rests by her boots as morning sunbeams stream through the station's high vaulted windows.
data.animaCaption: She slips the train ticket securely between the notebook pages, smoothing the paper with an eager smile for the journey ahead.
